headline: CPL Live Score 2026
lede: Caribbean Premier League (CPL) 2026 promises another thrilling season of T20 cricket, bringing together the Caribbean's top franchises and some of the biggest names in the game. Running from August 7 to September 20, 2026, the tournament features 35 league matches, three playoff games, and the CPL Final. Follow this page for live scores, ball-by-ball updates, match results, points table changes, and the latest news throughout the season. Every score and fixture is updated using the official local start time of the host venue, so you never miss a moment of the action.
source_note: The page displays scores supplied by the CPL match feed. If the connection drops, the last confirmed score stays on screen with a clear update notice.

faq.question: How often does the CPL live score update?
faq.answer: The page checks the CPL match feed every 15 seconds while it is open. You can also use the refresh button to check for the latest score immediately.

faq.question: Where can I find today's CPL match score?
faq.answer: The current-match panel at the top of this page shows today's CPL fixture, live score, overs and match status. Before play begins, it shows the start time, venue and countdown.

faq.question: Does the page show the toss and playing XI?
faq.answer: Yes. The toss result and confirmed playing XIs appear when they are published by the match feed. Before the toss, those fields remain clearly marked as pending.

faq.question: Where can I view the full CPL scorecard?
faq.answer: Select View full scorecard in the current-match panel. The match page includes innings details and the ball-by-ball match-centre view.
